title: Improved Cryopreservation of Human Induced Pluripotent Stem Cell (iPSC) and iPSC-derived Neurons Using Ice-Recrystallization Inhibitors
study_design: Primary IRI formulation study spanning a physical splat-cooling assay, HAF-iPSC viability/recovery, and post-mitotic iPSC-neuron viability, recovery, marker, and electrophysiology endpoints.

experiments.model: IRI solutions assessed by modified splat-cooling assay
experiments.cooling: 10 µL droplet frozen at −78 °C from 2 m onto polished aluminum block
experiments.warming: Annealed at −6.4 °C for 5 minutes on precooled Peltier stage
experiments.result: The assay generated IC50 curves; reported IC50 values were 4 mM (2FA), 12 mM (4ClA), 3 mM (PMA), and 11 mM (2,6 DFB).
experiments.sample_size: minimum of five concentrations per compound; image-based assay replicate details not specified here
experiments.evidence_excerpt: a minimum of five concentrations were investigated

experiments.model: HAF-iPSCs frozen in mFreSR with IRI dose series
experiments.intervention: mFreSR + 10 mM 2FA (lead), 0.5 mM 4ClA, or 15 mM PMA
experiments.result: Control viability was 46%; the highest reported values were 71% for 4ClA, 71.5% for 2FA, and 74.5% for PMA. At 48 h, 2FA reached 65.0% confluence versus 47.6% mFreSR control. Comparisons reported n=3.
experiments.sample_size: n=3 for plotted comparisons; confluence averaged 9 images per well across triplicate conditions
experiments.source_locator: Results, Post-thaw Viability of iPSCs and 2FA Improves Post-thaw Recovery; Fig. 1a-c
experiments.evidence_excerpt: the highest percent viability was observed

experiments.storage: approximately 1 month before thawing in the reported neuron experiment
experiments.result: Viability was 67.2% (5 mM 2FA), 65.3% (2.5 mM), 54% (CS10), and 45% (10 mM), without significant improvement. Recovery was 50.3% (5 mM) and 45.0% (10 mM) versus 32.2% CS10 and 35.0% 2.5 mM; the 5 and 10 mM groups were statistically significant versus the latter comparators.
experiments.sample_size: Figure 4 comparisons report n=3; independent donor count not established
experiments.source_locator: Results, 2FA Improves Recovery of Electrophysiologic Function of iPSC-Ns; Fig. 4b-c

experiments.intervention: 2FA cryopreservation at 2.5, 5, or 10 mM in CS10
experiments.outcome_name: Spontaneous/synchronous MEA network activity and drug responses
experiments.timepoint: recording began after 19 days in vitro; activity tracked through 236 days; pharmacology at 47 days
experiments.result: At 27 days after plating, 2.5 and 5 mM 2FA cultures showed robust synchronous activity, with robust bursting by day 48. CS10 and 10 mM 2FA cultures developed robust synchronous activity after day 130. Day-47 pharmacology assessed 5 mM 2FA cultures. Electrode observations are readout replicates; Figure 5 reports 3–4 MEAs and data representative of two independent differentiations.
experiments.sample_size: Figure 5: n=3–4 MEAs for longitudinal activity, n=3 for active-electrode summary; data representative of 2 independent differentiations
experiments.source_locator: Results, Functional Recovery of iPSC-Ns Post-Thaw; Fig. 5 and Methods MEA Recordings
experiments.evidence_excerpt: robust bursting behavior developing by 48 days

main_finding: 2FA improved HAF-iPSC survival/recovery and accelerated recovery of neuronal network function, while iPSC-neuron immediate viability itself was not significantly improved.
limitations: Y27632 is a recovery co-treatment; methods say with or without and condition-level allocation needs clarification before attributing downstream effects to 2FA alone.
Figure 4/5 legends name mFreSR in some control descriptions despite neuronal methods using CS10; retain this source inconsistency.
Electrodes and images are technical readouts; 3–4 MEAs and two differentiations do not establish broad independent donor replication.
The formulation arrays list alternative arms/doses, not a combined multi-IRI mixture.
2024 proprietary IRI-I cannot be assumed to be this disclosed 2FA molecule.
mechanism_claim: The physical IRI assay directly measures ice recrystallization inhibition; survival and neuronal function are downstream endpoints and do not by themselves prove a direct biological pathway mechanism.
reviewer: root; Luna extraction corrected against full methods/results and figure legends
